manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the handheld round blue cup onto the small drink-protecting wooden coaster.

Task description: Move the round blue cup currently on the left side of the table to the small round wooden coaster on its right, then release it.

Success criteria: The blue cup has been placed on the wooden coaster with their horizontal positions nearly overlapping, and lowered to a height supported by the coaster surface; both grippers are open and no longer holding the cup.

## Execution tips

- With the cup open, consider an unobstructed section below its rim facing the gripper. Grasp the wall with one finger inside and one outside for ample pad contact, leaving bottom clearance for seating.
- Match the gripper opening to the cup wall thickness and available space inside the rim. Before closing, confirm that both fingers are truly on opposite sides of the wall rather than merely overlapping in the image and pressing against the rim.
- Keep the cup opening upward during transport and its bottom above the table and coaster edges, avoiding scraping or hitting an edge and tipping it.
- Near the coaster surface, lower more slowly and minimize sideways pushing. Confirm the cup base is supported before releasing; when withdrawing the inner finger, avoid the rim so it does not lift or knock over the cup.
